src:
MOV     AX, 0004h        ; mode 04h: CGA 320x200, 4 colours
INT     10h
MOV     AH, 0Bh
MOV     BX, 0001h        ; BH = 0: background; BL = 1: blue
INT     10h
MOV     AH, 0Bh
MOV     BX, 0101h        ; BH = 1: palette; BL = 1
INT     10h
MOV     BX, 0001h        ; BH = page 0, BL = colour of the first bar
MOV     DX, 70           ; first row
BAND1:
MOV     SI, 10           ; 10 rows per bar
LINE1:
MOV     CX, 80           ; x from 80 to 239
DOT1:
MOV     AH, 0Ch          ; write a pixel: AL = colour, CX = x, DX = y
MOV     AL, BL
INT     10h
INC     CX
CMP     CX, 240
JB      DOT1
INC     DX
DEC     SI
JNZ     LINE1
ADD     DX, 10           ; a gap of 10 rows
INC     BL               ; the next colour
CMP     BL, 4
JB      BAND1
CALL    WAIT1            ; a second with palette 1
MOV     AH, 0Bh
MOV     BX, 0100h        ; BH = 1, BL = 0: palette 0
INT     10h
CALL    WAIT1            ; a second with palette 0
MOV     AX, 0003h        ; mode 03h again: 80x25 text, clears the screen
INT     10h
MOV     AH, 09h
MOV     DX, OFFSET MSG1
INT     21h

MSG1    DB      "Palette 1, then palette 0", 13, 10, "$"
WAIT1:                   ; wait 1 s: CX:DX = 0F4240h microseconds
MOV     CX, 000Fh
MOV     DX, 4240h
MOV     AH, 86h
INT     15h
RET
